# Lit AI Productions

> Lit AI Productions is a Long Island, NY web design and AI automation agency. We build custom websites, e-commerce stores, AI chatbots and automations, local SEO programs, and Cloudflare-powered hosting for small businesses, creators, and startups across Long Island, New York, and beyond.

## Core Pages

- [Home](/): Long Island web design and AI automation agency for small businesses.
- [Services](/services): Full list of web design, AI, SEO, hosting, and custom solutions.
- [AI Readiness Assessment](/ai-assessment): Free 2-minute quiz that scores how ready a business is for AI and automation, with personalized recommendations.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Recent client websites and projects.
- [About](/about): Our story, team, and approach.
- [Contact](/contact): Start a project, request a quote, or book a free consultation.
- [Blog](/blog): Insights on web design, local SEO, and AI automation.

## Services

- [Website Design](/services/website-design): Custom, conversion-focused websites.
- [Business Websites](/services/business-websites): Local small business websites that rank and convert.
- [AI Automation](/services/ai-automation): Chatbots, lead capture, and workflow automation.
- [E-commerce Development](/services/ecommerce-development): Custom online stores built to sell.
- [Landing Pages](/services/landing-pages): High-converting pages for paid traffic.
- [SEO Optimization](/services/seo-optimization): Local, technical, and AI search SEO.
- [Website Maintenance](/services/website-maintenance): Updates, backups, and security.
- [Cloudflare Hosting & Security](/services/cloudflare-hosting-security): Fast, secure global hosting.
- [Custom Business Solutions](/services/custom-business-solutions): Custom apps, dashboards, AI tools.
